cards.name: Mushroom Man
cards.description: Found in moist areas, this monster launches poison spores against its enemies.

cards.name: Man-eating Plant
cards.description: A meat-eating plant that is attractive to the eye but dangerous when approached.

cards.name: Dark Plant
cards.description: A vicious flower raised from polluted soil and fertilized by dark forces.

cards.name: Firegrass
cards.description: A fire-breathing plant found growing near volcanoes.

cards.name: Man Eater
cards.description: Man-eating plant with poison feelers for attacking enemies.

cards.name: Arlownay
cards.description: A maiden in the flower blossoms spreads poisonous pollen against opponents.

cards.name: Yashinoki
cards.description: A palm tree with a will of its own that attacks enemies by flinging coconuts.

cards.name: Ancient Tree of Enlightenment
cards.description: Armed with a wealth of knowledge, this monster is able to block just about any attack.

cards.name: Green Phantom King
cards.description: This youthful king of the forests lives in a green world, abundant with trees and wildlife.

cards.name: Rainbow Flower
cards.description: A flower creature with rainbow-colored blossoms that lure an enemy into its waiting jaws.

cards.name: Barrel Lily
cards.description: A dangerous flower that fire pollen projectiles.

cards.name: Laughing Flower
cards.description: A laughing flower whose chuckles can drive an enemy mad.

cards.name: Bean Soldier
cards.description: A plant warrior that attacks with a combination of sword-swings and pea projectiles.

cards.name: Griggle
cards.description: This monster spins about its enemy launching blinding leaves and painful seeds.

cards.name: Darkworld Thorns
cards.description: A thorny plant found in the darklands that wraps itself around any unwary traveler.

cards.name: Abyss Flower
cards.description: A rare flower that blooms in a pitch-dark abyss.

cards.name: Living Vase
cards.description: A living vase that blinds enemies with pollen and attacks with its sharp teeth.

cards.name: Tentacle Plant
cards.description: Attacks nearby opponents by reaching out with its blue vines.

cards.name: Rose Spectre of Dunn
cards.description: A red rose possessed by a vile spirit that feeds on the life force of others to provide the flower with nourishment.

cards.name: Snakeyashi
cards.description: A creature made up of several snakes that attack separately in battle.

cards.name: Trent
cards.description: A protector of the forest. This massive tree continues to grow.

cards.name: Queen of Autumn Leaves
cards.description: Queen of the tree spirit who is embraced by brilliant autumn leaves.
